intent: Extract the sequences of the three 20 bp primer binding sites listed in primer_sites.bed (BED: chromosome, start, end) from genome.fa into a FASTA file.
silent_error: A BED line is 0-based, half-open, but a samtools faidx region string chr:start-end is 1-based and inclusive (samtools-view man page, Regions: 'RNAME[:STARTPOS[-ENDPOS]] and all position coordinates are 1-based'; the same region syntax is used by samtools faidx). Pasting the BED start and end into the region string returns end-start+1 = 21 bases starting one base to the left of the primer, so every sequence is one base too long and shifted. faidx exits 0 and prints no warning; the FASTA headers look right and the sequences are plausible DNA.

files.primer_sites.bed:
chr7	10	30	KRAS_F
chr7	150	170	KRAS_R
chr12	60	80	TP53_F

faulted: awk '{print $1":"$2"-"$3}' primer_sites.bed | xargs samtools faidx genome.fa > primer_seqs.fa
clean: awk '{print $1":"$2+1"-"$3}' primer_sites.bed | xargs samtools faidx genome.fa > primer_seqs.fa
